timestamp_semantics: calendar datetime; naive values use computational zero-offset only, acquisition timezone unknown; aware elapsed time; clock uses supplied calendar midnight
image_path_semantics: absolute or relative to data_root; never infer from image filename
GT_semantics: audited union_pixels and n_instances; area_fraction cross-checked, no new masks inferred
RGB_validity: inventory hash present plus file exists and PIL pixel decode and dimensions match; content hashes not recomputed
physical_ROI: provisional: fixed pixel field area fraction conditional on unverified physical ROI scale
limitations: No physical ROI calibration or cross-plant biological ranking

statistics.common_feasibility_definition: all 26 non-oracle plans including all R draws and GT-online succeed; never conditioned on error pass
statistics.ranking: not_computed: comparable physical ROI, age/batch and identical L not established
statistics.random_aggregation: mean within plant first; draw pass fraction and plant q90 retained

quantile_models.solver: scipy L-BFGS-B; check-loss smoothing=1e-6 log units
quantile_models.weight_definition: each TRAIN plant's total successful U replay weight is 1
